verdict.rationale: The SDK provides the building blocks for task-specialized assistants: system prompts that set the model's role and constraints for a whole exchange, registered tools with an SDK-managed execution loop, and a voice session that combines STT, LLM and TTS. There is no first-class feature for creating, saving or reusing named custom assistants, so a power-user has to assemble them in code. Missing for 10: a dedicated custom-assistant or persona configuration feature, saved and reusable assistant profiles, a non-code (CLI/UI) way to define assistants, and independent corroboration.
